description: Dynamically adjust the SIMD processing chunk size based on runtime conditions: use larger chunks (512-bit AVX-512) for long stretches of unquoted data and smaller chunks (128-bit SSE/NEON) near quote-heavy regions. Inspired by adaptive mesh refinement in computational fluid dynamics.
mathematical_formalization: Q_density(block) = popcount(quote_bitmask) / W. If Q_density < threshold_low, use W_max; if > threshold_high, use W_min. Expected throughput: T = sum_blocks W_block / C(W_block).
analogical_connections: CFD adaptive mesh refinement: fine grids near boundaries, coarse elsewhere
Variable-rate audio/video encoding: more bits for complex segments
OS huge pages vs. regular pages: matching granularity to access pattern
implementation_hypothesis: After Phase 1 detection with max chunk size, compute quote density per 64-byte block. Re-process high-density regions with 16-byte chunks for precise state tracking.
experiment_seed: Compare fixed vs. adaptive chunking on CSV with 0%, clustered, and random 50% quoting. Measure throughput and correctness.
